name: Emil Kozicki
headline: Software Engineer
summary: I'm a software engineer in Charlotte, NC. Most recently at Bridge Investment Group, I connected systems that weren't built to talk to each other, like AWS, Salesforce and third-party APIs, and figured out why data wasn't flowing the way it should. I enjoy the detective work of a tricky production bug just as much as building a feature from the data model all the way to the UI. I have an M.S. in Computer Science from UNC Charlotte, and I built this site (and its AI assistant) to show a little of how I work. I'm open to new software engineering roles, so if you're hiring, I'd love to hear from you.

experience.tech: Python, AWS Lambda, Step Functions, S3, Salesforce, Apex, LWC
highlights: Resolved production data-sync failures across AWS Lambda integrations linking Salesforce to third-party property-management vendors.

Shipped a Deferred Work Items feature end-to-end, from a new Salesforce data model to the UI in an offline-first SvelteKit PWA, then led the incident response when a related schema change caused stuck field submissions, recovering the lost data.
Built a bulk photo-export feature for a property inspection platform: a Lightning Web Component and Apex layer calling an AWS Lambda.

projects.name: AI Portfolio Site
projects.tech: React, Vite, Django REST Framework, Google Gemini API
projects.description: This site — a React front end backed by a Django REST API, with an AI assistant that answers visitor questions about my background.
highlights: Built a Django REST API that proxies chat requests to Gemini, keeping the API key server-side.
Hardened the assistant against prompt injection and abuse with input isolation, no tool access, rate limiting and request/token caps.
Built a contact pipeline that saves messages before emailing, so nothing is lost if email delivery fails.

projects.name: CLT Events
projects.description: Full-stack web application for event creation, browsing, RSVP management, and user profile handling.
highlights: Implemented secure authentication with hashed passwords and persistent sessions in MongoDB.
Built event CRUD with image uploads, validation, category filtering and RSVP rules.
Built a profile dashboard showing hosted events and RSVP history.
